description: This XML file defines a 'simple-method' for generating a report related to sales order data, including conditions, iterations, and calculations, within the Ofbiz framework. It encapsulates the logic for retrieving order information, aggregating data based on sales channels and date schemas, and setting various fields for report presentation.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Main method to fetch and process sales order data, including setting parameters, iterating over sales channels and date schemas, and performing calculations for report generation.
